kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تقتعدون (form VIII)
# تَقْتَعِدُونَ (taqtaʕidūna) /taq.ta.ʕi.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# تُقْتَعَدُونَ (tuqtaʕadūna) /tuq.ta.ʕa.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
